title: Fyntiq
summary: A US financial platform with three connected products on one network: a consumer wallet for holding, sending and spending across borders, a business platform for invoicing and accounting, and pay-at-the-table for restaurants. I built responsive product interfaces and the secure transaction flows that run through them.

image.alt: The Fyntiq home page, headlined “Pick your Fyntiq”, with cards for its wallet, business and restaurant products

title: Addlly AI
summary: An enterprise AI marketing platform whose brand-trained agents create, optimise and audit content for visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google. I worked on the application interface and the API integrations behind one-click blog, social and newsletter generation.

image.alt: The Addlly AI home page, headlined “The AI Search Visibility Platform for Enterprise Brands”

title: APMS
summary: A platform for the Georgian Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture that administers state agricultural support programmes end to end: applicant intake, beneficiary verification, document management, approval workflow and disbursement tracking. I delivered the administrative console, with multi-role permissions, a multilingual UI and exportable reporting for ministry staff.

image.alt: A laptop showing a data dashboard with charts, standing in for the ministry console, which is not public

title: M&ES
summary: A planning, monitoring and evaluation platform for the same ministry, tracking programme indicators and results across national agriculture and rural-development strategies. I built the indicator-management, data-entry and reporting modules, with dashboards that let departments and donor partners watch progress against targets.

image.alt: A laptop showing analytics charts, standing in for the monitoring platform, which is not public

title: WRB
summary: A national ward record system that replaces paper ward books with structured electronic patient records, so clinical staff work from one accurate source. I implemented the patient admission and record-management modules, role-based clinical access and audit-ready data handling.

image.alt: A laptop and phone side by side on a counter, standing in for the clinical record system, whose screens are behind a client login

title: Solstice Health
summary: An AI-native platform for life-sciences and biopharma marketing teams that pre-screens content against medical-legal-regulatory requirements, turning a compliance review that took weeks into one that takes minutes. I built the interactive dashboards and the review workflows for evaluation, versioning and collaborative sign-off.

image.alt: A large monitor showing a layout open in a design tool, standing in for the review platform, which is behind a login

title: GiftXD
summary: A marketplace that converts gift cards into cryptocurrency, with a matching engine that surfaces the best available exchange rate. I developed the trading interface, the offer matching screens and the wallet integration flows.

image.alt: Source code on a dark screen, standing in for the trading interface, which is not public

title: SnT Global
summary: A single-dashboard logistics product giving clients real-time visibility to view, track and manage inventory and orders across Southeast Asia. I implemented the order-tracking dashboard, the inventory modules and role-based client access.

image.alt: The SnT Global home page, headlined “Take charge of your logistics”, over a photograph of a fulfilment warehouse
